name: blackboard
description: Blackboard TextMate-inspired dark and light themes for Visual Studio Code.

scripts.install: npm run install:codex && npm run install:ghostty && npm run install:zed && npm run install:vscode
scripts.install:vscode: command -v code >/dev/null || { echo 'install:vscode: no code CLI on PATH, skipping' >&2; exit 0; }; [ -f ./blackboard-${npm_package_version}.vsix ] || npm run package; code --install-extension ./blackboard-${npm_package_version}.vsix --force
